'''Revelation There Is Good In Him...I know it!''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Revelation]]
* '''Published:''' 7 January 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]

* '''Strategy:''' There Is Good In Him
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 TIGIH Revelation LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

Strategy: Pretty simple. Use Strike Planning to pull Madine and General Solo and Chewbacca Of Kashyyyk. Play Solo and Chewie with Luke at the Landing Platform while Madine sits at Chief Chirpa?s Hut pulling Midge, Panno, and Kensaric. Even if your opponent captures Luke with an Imp, you?re gonna win at the Landing Platform. Play Life Debt and Rebel Leadership, draw four destiny and cancel his. Kaboom. Then use Midge to add to your drain there, and Kensaric to make it hard for them to beat you down. Getting cards on I Feel The Conflict should not be difficult. Sheesh, you might even be able to play Leia With Blaster Rifle and draw FIVE destiny!!! Please don?t rag on this deck because of bad generation- I get six off the bat, Panno adds to generation, and G Solo and Chewie OK deploy ?2 to Endor, while the other pulled people are cheap. The other expensive characters are for one turn plop beatdowns. Rogue Assassin: Tunnel Vision gets ANY card from the force pile. This saves the force you need to deploy that card. I'm not dropping a single Life Debt. Oddly enough, I was just about to fix the I Feel The Conflict mixup! bigchief_04: Kensaric helps prevent that dropping. If that ever DOES get dropped, I'll cancel his destiny and play Life Debt. 'Puny scouts', are they? Yeah, you're right, but they're some kinda mean puny scouts. As for all my 'air', a drain is a drain1. Aquaris adds to my generation, and Opponent's generation at Endor is canceled. The thing I hate most is playing weak space and having my opponent playing a ton of space. Another thing I hate is not owning the You Cannot Hide Forever shield. Sheesh! This guy was playing cheesy inserts at a tournament and I lost 20 force to them because of not having that shield!!! Who plays Hidden Base with inserts, anyway? cootees: As I have said before, I don't have any Qui-Gon With Lightsabers. Nor two HCATF's. AS I SAID BEFORE, 'The thing I hate most is playing weak space and having my opponent playing a ton of space.' bountyhunter6: I have a guaranteed Han and Chewie. Why drop a Life Debt? Also, I only have seven starships. How is that too much? I like to call it a miniswarm.
